errors.evidence: The description states the red line (ChemBART Small 20M) is near a training loss of ~0.20 at the 20k step. However, the plot shows the red line is visibly below the 0.2 grid line at this step, at a value closer to ~0.18.

The description states the blue line (ChemBART Medium 20M) is at a training loss of roughly ~0.20 at the 20k step. The plot shows this line is below the 0.2 grid line, at a value closer to ~0.17, making ~0.20 a significant overestimation.
